description: Header file defining the MachoWalker class for iterating over load commands in a Mach-O file, including callback mechanisms and file/memory handling.

classes.name: MachoWalker
classes.description: Class for walking through Mach-O file headers and load commands, with callback support.

methods.name: WalkHeader
methods.description: Begins walking the header for specified CPU type and subtype.

methods.name: ReadBytes
methods.description: Reads bytes from the file or memory at a given offset.

methods.name: CurrentHeader
methods.description: Returns the current header and its offset.
